units.source_text: 次日，源氏公子将出门时，左大臣特来看视。

en.t: The next day, as Prince Genji was about to go out, the Minister of the Left came specially to see him.

units.source_text: 公子正在装束，左大臣亲自拿一条名贵的玉带来送他，并且亲手替他整理官袍背后的折纹。

en.t: While the prince was dressing, the Minister of the Left personally brought him a precious jeweled belt as a gift, and with his own hands arranged the folds at the back of his court robe.

units.source_text: 照顾之周到，只差没有亲手替他穿靴。

en.t: His attentiveness was so complete that only putting on the prince's boots for him was left undone.

units.source_text: 父母爱子之心，令人感动。

en.t: The heart of a parent loving a child was deeply moving.

units.source_text: 源氏公子辞谢道：“如此名贵之玉带，且待他日侍内宴时，再受惠赐。”

en.t: Prince Genji declined with thanks, saying, "For such a precious jeweled belt, please let me receive your gracious gift another day, when I attend an imperial banquet."

units.source_text: 左大臣答道：“他日另有更上品者。

en.t: The Minister of the Left replied, "On another day there will be an even finer one.

units.source_text: 此不足贵，但式样新奇耳。”

en.t: This one is not especially valuable; its style is merely new and unusual."

units.source_text: 便强把玉带系在他身上了。

en.t: Then he insisted on fastening the jeweled belt around him.

units.source_text: 如此无微不至地爱护，在左大臣视为乐事。

en.t: To the Minister of the Left, caring for him with such meticulous tenderness was a pleasure.

units.source_text: 此种机会虽然不易多得，但能眼看如此俊美之人物出入其家，他认为是无上之幸福。

en.t: Although such opportunities were not easy to come by, he considered it the highest happiness to see such a beautiful person coming and going in his household.
